name: @nostrautica/e2e
_scripts_note: The Playwright suite is deliberately NOT called `test`. As `test` it was picked
up by `pnpm -r test`, where it starts `vite preview` on :4173 and — with no
app build present, i.e. on a fresh checkout — hangs until Playwright's 120 s
webServer timeout, at which point pnpm's RECURSIVE_RUN_FIRST_FAIL aborts the
whole run BEFORE the app and coordinator suites. Only the protocol package's
242 tests ever reported, so `pnpm -r test` silently under-reported by ~1,900
tests while looking like it had run everything.
Run these through the orchestrator (`pnpm e2e:smoke` and friends), which owns
the relay/Blossom/proxy lifecycle; `pnpm e2e` is the bare-preview form.
